info.title: Kodi JSON-RPC notifications
info.description: Server-initiated notifications of Kodi's JSON-RPC 2.0 API. Kodi pushes these over the WebSocket and raw TCP transports only; they are never delivered over HTTP. Request/response methods are documented separately in openrpc.json.

tcp.description: Raw TCP transport; newline-free JSON-RPC objects over a plain socket.

jsonrpc.description: The single JSON-RPC channel; every notification is delivered on it.

Player.OnPlay.name: Player.OnPlay
Player.OnPlay.summary: Playback of a media item has been started or the playback speed has changed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnResume.name: Player.OnResume
Player.OnResume.summary: Playback of a media item has been resumed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnAVStart.name: Player.OnAVStart
Player.OnAVStart.summary: Playback of a media item has been started and first frame is available. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnAVChange.name: Player.OnAVChange
Player.OnAVChange.summary: Audio- or videostream has changed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnPause.name: Player.OnPause
Player.OnPause.summary: Playback of a media item has been paused. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnStop.name: Player.OnStop
Player.OnStop.summary: Playback of a media item has been stopped. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

end.description: Whether the player has reached the end of the playable item(s) or not

Player.OnPlaybackFailed.name: Player.OnPlaybackFailed
Player.OnPlaybackFailed.summary: Playback of a media item was requested but did not happen. Playback starts asynchronously, so a request that was answered successfully can still fail afterwards.

reason.description: Why the item was not played. "unplayable": no player could play it, or the player refused it. "unresolved": a plugin did not return a playable item. "locked": the master or media source lock refused it. "error": the player reported an error after playback had started.

Player.OnSpeedChanged.name: Player.OnSpeedChanged
Player.OnSpeedChanged.summary: Speed of the playback of a media item has been changed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnSeek.name: Player.OnSeek
Player.OnSeek.summary: The playback position has been changed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnPropertyChanged.name: Player.OnPropertyChanged
Player.OnPropertyChanged.summary: A property of the playing items has changed.

Playlist.OnAdd.name: Playlist.OnAdd
Playlist.OnAdd.summary: A playlist item has been added.

Playlist.OnRemove.name: Playlist.OnRemove
Playlist.OnRemove.summary: A playlist item has been removed.

Playlist.OnClear.name: Playlist.OnClear
Playlist.OnClear.summary: A playlist item has been cleared.

Playlist.OnPropertyChanged.name: Playlist.OnPropertyChanged
Playlist.OnPropertyChanged.summary: A property of the playlist has changed. Unlike Player.OnPropertyChanged this is also sent when the playlist is not currently being played.

AudioLibrary.OnUpdate.name: AudioLibrary.OnUpdate
AudioLibrary.OnUpdate.summary: An audio item has been updated.

transaction.description: True if the update is being performed within a transaction.

added.description: True if the update is for a newly added item.

AudioLibrary.OnRemove.name: AudioLibrary.OnRemove
AudioLibrary.OnRemove.summary: An audio item has been removed.

transaction.description: True if the removal is being performed within a transaction.

AudioLibrary.OnScanStarted.name: AudioLibrary.OnScanStarted
AudioLibrary.OnScanStarted.summary: An audio library scan has started.

AudioLibrary.OnScanFinished.name: AudioLibrary.OnScanFinished
AudioLibrary.OnScanFinished.summary: Scanning the audio library has been finished.

AudioLibrary.OnCleanStarted.name: AudioLibrary.OnCleanStarted
AudioLibrary.OnCleanStarted.summary: An audio library clean operation has started.

AudioLibrary.OnCleanFinished.name: AudioLibrary.OnCleanFinished
AudioLibrary.OnCleanFinished.summary: The audio library has been cleaned.

AudioLibrary.OnExport.name: AudioLibrary.OnExport
AudioLibrary.OnExport.summary: An audio library export has finished.

VideoLibrary.OnUpdate.name: VideoLibrary.OnUpdate
VideoLibrary.OnUpdate.summary: A video item has been updated.

transaction.description: True if the update is being performed within a transaction.

added.description: True if the update is for a newly added item.

VideoLibrary.OnExport.name: VideoLibrary.OnExport
VideoLibrary.OnExport.summary: A video library export has finished.

VideoLibrary.OnRemove.name: VideoLibrary.OnRemove
VideoLibrary.OnRemove.summary: A video item has been removed.

transaction.description: True if the removal is being performed within a transaction.

VideoLibrary.OnScanStarted.name: VideoLibrary.OnScanStarted
VideoLibrary.OnScanStarted.summary: A video library scan has started.

VideoLibrary.OnScanFinished.name: VideoLibrary.OnScanFinished
VideoLibrary.OnScanFinished.summary: Scanning the video library has been finished.

VideoLibrary.OnCleanStarted.name: VideoLibrary.OnCleanStarted
VideoLibrary.OnCleanStarted.summary: A video library clean operation has started.

VideoLibrary.OnCleanFinished.name: VideoLibrary.OnCleanFinished
VideoLibrary.OnCleanFinished.summary: The video library has been cleaned.

VideoLibrary.OnRefresh.name: VideoLibrary.OnRefresh
VideoLibrary.OnRefresh.summary: The video library has been refreshed and a home screen reload might be necessary.

System.OnWake.name: System.OnWake
System.OnWake.summary: The system woke up from suspension.

System.OnLowBattery.name: System.OnLowBattery
System.OnLowBattery.summary: The system is on low battery.

Application.OnVolumeChanged.name: Application.OnVolumeChanged
Application.OnVolumeChanged.summary: The volume of the application has changed.

Input.OnInputRequested.name: Input.OnInputRequested
Input.OnInputRequested.summary: The user is requested to provide some information.

Input.OnInputFinished.name: Input.OnInputFinished
Input.OnInputFinished.summary: The user has provided the requested input.

GUI.OnSkinUnloading.name: GUI.OnSkinUnloading
GUI.OnSkinUnloading.summary: The current skin is about to be unloaded.

Settings.OnLevelChanged.name: Settings.OnLevelChanged
Settings.OnLevelChanged.summary: The setting level in force has changed. The profile's settings lock can lower it without the viewer asking for it.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, en-AU), empty when the stream declares none, passed through unchanged when unrecognized

anyOf.description: An unknown item does not have any additional information.
An item known to the database has an identification.
A movie item has a title and may have a release year.
A tv episode has a title and may have an episode number, season number and the title of the show it belongs to.
A music video has a title and may have an album and an artist.
A song has a title and may have an album, an artist and a track number.
A picture has a file path.
A PVR channel is either a radio or tv channel and has a title.
